checker.title: M365 Security Assessment
checker.desc: 5 questions · Instant results · No registration required
checker.question: Question {current} of {total}

questions.text: Is Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) enforced for all users?
questions.sub: MFA is the single most effective control against credential-based attacks. It should be mandatory — not optional — for every account including service accounts and administrators.

partial.title: Partially — some users only
partial.hint: Not consistently enforced across all accounts

no.title: No — not enabled
no.hint: Users sign in with password only

unknown.title: Not sure
unknown.hint: I'd need to check the tenant to confirm

questions.text: Are Conditional Access policies configured in your tenant?
questions.sub: Conditional Access lets you enforce granular access controls based on user, device, location and sign-in risk — it's the foundation of a Zero Trust identity model in Microsoft 365.

yes.title: Yes — actively configured
yes.hint: Multiple policies in Enabled or Report-only state

partial.title: Basic policies only
partial.hint: MFA for admins only, or default Security Defaults

no.title: Not configured
no.hint: No Conditional Access policies in place

unknown.title: Not sure
unknown.hint: I'd need to check Entra ID to confirm

questions.text: Is legacy authentication blocked in your environment?
questions.sub: Legacy authentication protocols (Basic Auth, IMAP, POP3) bypass MFA entirely and are exploited in the majority of password spray and credential stuffing attacks against M365 tenants.

yes.title: Yes — fully blocked
yes.hint: Legacy auth blocked via Conditional Access or Auth Policy

partial.title: Partially restricted
partial.hint: Some protocols blocked, others still active

unknown.title: Not sure
unknown.hint: I'd need to check the sign-in logs to confirm

questions.text: Is external sharing in SharePoint and OneDrive restricted?
questions.sub: Unrestricted external sharing is one of the most common sources of unintentional data exposure in M365. Default tenant settings are often too permissive for most business risk profiles.

yes.title: Yes — restricted to known domains
yes.hint: Sharing limited to authenticated external users or specific domains

partial.title: Limited sharing permitted
partial.hint: External sharing allowed with authentication required

no.title: Open — anyone with a link
no.hint: Files can be shared publicly without authentication

unknown.title: Not sure
unknown.hint: I'd need to check SharePoint Admin Center

questions.text: Are Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels deployed and actively used?
questions.sub: Sensitivity labels classify and protect documents and emails based on their confidentiality level — a hard prerequisite for safe Copilot deployment and GDPR/DSGVO data governance obligations.

yes.title: Yes — deployed and actively used
yes.hint: Labels configured in Purview and applied to files and emails

partial.title: Created but not widely adopted
partial.hint: Labels exist but usage is low or inconsistent

unknown.title: Not sure
unknown.hint: I'd need to check Microsoft Purview
